I'll run the 631 pairs as 4 parallel shards through bg.py, writing as they go so a stopped run can resume. Adding a shard option first:26 judged so far, all with valid quotes, about 13 a minute, so roughly 45 more minutes. Reading the first three conflicts to see whether they're real:They look like real candidates. The noVNC one in particular: one memory says the noVNC surface is running and a later one says "Not set up yet". I'll wait for the shards to finish.㊢ ("let's go with haiku") The judge is running as 4 bg.py shards, so it will survive between my turns. Results go to `~/code/data/minus40/judged/haiku-{0..3}.jsonl` and are written as each pair finishes, so a stopped shard resumes where it left off. At about 13 pairs a minute, all 631 should be done in roughly 45 minutes. The job ids are `bg-1791677032201-454` to `…-457`.

㊢ (early results) In the first 26 judgements every quote checked out. 11 pairs were unrelated, 6 restate each other, 6 are replacements and 3 are conflicts. The conflicts look like real ones:
- **noVNC:** one memory says the noVNC browser surface is running, and a later memory says it is "Not set up yet".
- **codex-18/19:** one memory says the two seats were retired and deregistered, another says they paused cleanly, both on 10-04.
- **a1 cascade:** two memories give incompatible explanations for the same empty a1 cascade results.

㊢ (loader is ready) `minus40.sorries` turns the verdicts into futon1b records. Only verdicts with verbatim quotes are used.
- **conflict:** a sorry, written as a futon3c-shaped challenge plus a `:memory/sorry` edge.
- **restates:** a `:memory/restates` edge.
- **replaces:** a `:memory/supersede-proposed` edge from the older memory to the newer one. It isn't applied, since a model made the call.
- **Commands:** `list` shows open sorries with both quotes. `discharge <id> a|b|both|neither <note>` closes one and keeps the open period in history.
- **Challenged state:** a memory counts as `:challenged` (futon2's term) while an open sorry touches it, so no version edges get rewritten.

🈰 (next) When the shards finish, I'll load everything into the scratch store, check the counts and some samples against the source, commit, and send you the list of open sorries.

At about 4 tokens/s, I'd estimate 8–10 hours. That's an overnight load on the shared box, so I'd rather you okay it.
